Mercurius Iodatus Ruber      (Bin-iodide of Mercury.)



Again, if in a   Merc  . patient with diphtheria, tonsillitis, etc., the
        inflammation and pain begin on the    left      side, and incline to remain there or spread to the right, the   bin-iodide   is indicated.


These two iodides have more rapid and greater induration beneath ulcers
        and chancres than    Merc  .,    and in old syphilitics the iodides are sometimes more useful.
